header: You already put tills on counters. Put ours there too
subheader: Forty firms in Austria, southern Germany and South Tyrol do that already.
lead: We do not sell past you. A shop that comes through you stays with you, renewals included, and we say so in writing.
bodytext:
What is expected in return: two people through the training, at least three installations a year, and a first line of support that answers the same day. Below three installations the training stops paying for itself, for you as much as for us.

What is not expected: an exclusivity clause, a stock commitment, or a promise not to sell anybody else's till. Half our partners carry two systems, and the ones who are honest about which suits a shop better keep their customers longest.
note: Applications are looked at together once a month. Where a region is already well covered we say so instead of leaving it open.

benefits.title: Your margin stays yours
benefits.text: 30 per cent on the first year and 15 per cent for as long as the shop is looked after by you.

benefits.title: Two days of training
benefits.text: Once in spring in Linz, once in autumn online. Free, and required before a first installation.

benefits.title: A number that is not the hotline
benefits.text: Partners reach the two people who already know their open cases, not the general queue.

benefits.title: Material with your name on it
benefits.text: Data sheets and price lists carrying your logo, so nobody has to rebuild them in a word processor.
